ns2:course.label: Analysis of Musical Form
ns2:course.description: (MUSIC 308) Extensive study of the formal structure of representative musical compositions from various historical periods: (a) Renaissance and Baroque; (b) Viennese classical; (c) nineteenth century; (d) first half of twentieth century; and (e) since World War II. 3 undergraduate hours. 2 graduate hours. Maximum of 9 undergraduate hours or 6 graduate hours. Prerequisite: MUS 202 and MUS 208.
